title: Annotatio III §.IX: Without ENIM some call the Form incomplete — Transsubstantiation not fully confected (Picherellus)
pass_a_gloss: See Picherellus Opusc. Theol. §. 8.; Nay, others opine such necessity of inserting the said little conjunctive word that apart from its addition they call the Form of the Sacrament incomplete — i.e. Transsubstantiation not fully confected.
pass_b_english: Picherellus (Opusc. Theol. §.8) is cited on this.
Others press the little word so hard that without adding ENIM they call the Form incomplete — Transsubstantiation not fully done.
source_text: Vid. Picherellum Opusc. Theol. §. 8.; Quin, tantam interferendæ dictæ voculæ conjunctivæ necessitatem opinantibus aliis, ut citra ejus adjectionem Sacramenti Formam incompletam, i. e. Transsubstantiationem haud plenè confectam dicant.
